The MXV-0808-H2A-KIT delivers the same powerful performance as the standalone MXV-0808-H2A matrix switcher, now bundled with 6 standard HDBaseT receivers and 2 scaling receivers—making it an ideal solution for installations with a mix of 4K and 1080p displays. Capable of transmitting full 18Gbps HDMI content up to 35m/115ft using WyreStorm’s advanced lossless compression (VLC), this kit maintains perfect signal integrity without compromising color fidelity—unlike other methods such as CSC that permanently discard color data. With 8 HDBaseT zone outputs and 4 mirrored HDMI outputs, plus CEC triggering across all 12 display connections, the MXV-0808-H2A-KIT ensures seamless video distribution in residential or commercial environments where display compatibility and reliability are key.

In addition to the audio breakout ports, the MXV 8×8 also features four HDMI mirrored output ports which can be paired with any of WyreStorm’s HAOC hybrid optical HDMI cables for transmission up to 50m/164ft or any extender for transmission of HDBaseT or OM3 fiber.
